title: Mike McConnell as Dan Burisch's godfather

tellings.quote: There's some weird stories around Dan Barish where I think his like godfather was Mike McConnell

plain: A man named Mike McConnell is said to have been the godfather of a man named Dan Burisch, who has a story of his own in this subject. Michels brings it up in passing as one of several "weird stories" around Burisch, passing on something he has heard, with a man named Brian Jackson among the names he cites. He gives no detail, but if it were true it would tie Burisch personally to McConnell.
